name: Enterprise Document, Knowledge and Terminology
constraints: WM-REC-001 owns stable record identity, immutable versions, instantiations, custody and disposition.
WM-KNW-006 owns persistent concept identity and intrinsic meaning.
WM-KNW-018 owns scheme identity, immutable releases and release-scoped membership, relation and mapping assertions.
Every assertion has one editable master; cross-model views are read-only.
Document classification pins concept identity and exact scheme release; a label alone is insufficient.
A URL, file or carrier is a location or instantiation and never record identity.
Digest proves byte state and never document or concept identity.
Lexical equality never establishes concept identity.
Definitions preserve source, provenance, language, context, status and dispute state.
Scheme-local withdrawal never globally deprecates a concept.
Published record versions and scheme releases are append-only and never renumbered.
